title: Google AI Ultra plan brings ad-free YouTube to the whole family
excerpt: YouTube Premium Individual goes Family on the Ultra tier
content_html:
Published Nov 18, 2026, 11:57 PM EST

I've been writing about Android since 2011, with a focus on device reviews, Samsung and Google Pixel hardware, and the latest happenings in the ecosystem. In my entire writing career, I've reviewed more than 75 Android phones.

Carrying both a Samsung or Pixel flagship and an iPhone as a daily driver provides me with deep insight into how Android works and how it compares to iOS.

I have been writing for Android Police since 2021, covering news, how-tos, and features. You can find my previous work on Neowin, AndroidBeat, Times of India, iPhoneHacks, MySmartPrice, and MakeUseOf.

When not working, I tend to mindlessly scroll through X, play with new AI models, or go on long road trips. You can reach out to me on X or drop a mail at rajesh@androidpolice.com.

Google sweetens its pricey AI Ultra plans with perks that go well beyond Gemini, from generous cloud storage to bundled subscriptions. Earlier this year, it introduced a new $100-per-month Ultra tier and upgraded both Ultra plans to bundle YouTube Premium Individual subscription for free. Now, Google is making the plan even more attractive by upgrading the bundled YouTube Premium subscription from Individual to Family.

Many Google AI Ultra subscribers on Reddit report receiving an email from Google in the last few days about their YouTube Premium membership being automatically upgraded from Individual to Family at no extra cost. Google also officially announced the change today, confirming the free YouTube Premium Family plan upgrade comes at no extra cost.

That means you can now add up to five additional family members living in the same household to your YouTube Premium subscription. However, the YouTube Premium Family plan can only be shared if the Google AI Ultra subscriber is the family manager.

Everyone can use their own Google account, keeping their watch history, recommendations, and subscriptions separate, while enjoying an ad-free playback experience with support for offline downloads and background playback. Even better, they can use YouTube Music Premium at no extra cost.

In June this year, YouTube Premium subscription prices went up in the US. The individual plan got a $2 hike, from $13.99 to $15.99, while the Family plan received a bigger $4 hike, from $22.99 to $26.99 per month.

So, Google bundling YouTube Premium Family with its Ultra tier AI plan makes it an even more attractive option. Plus, it makes Ultra’s $100 or $200 monthly price easier to justify, especially if you already pay for YouTube Premium Family separately. In that case, as a household, you'll save nearly $324 a year.

More reasons to go Ultra

The YouTube Premium Family benefit comes on top of Google AI Ultra’s other perks, including 20 TB or 30 TB of cloud storage, Google Home Premium Advanced, and Google Health Premium. Subscribers also get Gemini features in Gmail, Docs, and Vids, alongside higher limits for Google Flow’s AI image and video generation tools. That's on top of access to other cutting-edge AI features such as auto browse in Gemini in Chrome, AI inbox, Project Genie, and more.

With Google also improving its latest AI models with the launch of Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen, Ultra’s usage limits—five or 20 times those of AI Pro—now offer even better value.

Google's AI Ultra plans already offered more value for money than the similarly priced $100 and $200 plans from ChatGPT and Claude. The improved Google YouTube Premium Family Plan perk makes it an even better deal now.
